homepage.intro1: mRemoteNG (Multi-Remote Next Generation), abbreviated as mR, is an open-source, tabbed remote connections manager for Windows.
homepage.intro2: It allows you to view all of your remote connections in a simple yet powerful interface and supports multiple protocols including RDP, VNC, SSH, HTTP/S and more.

contributePage.title: Contribute to mRemoteNG
contributePage.heading: Contribute & Support
contributePage.intro: mRemoteNG is open-source software built and maintained by community contributors. There are many ways you can help support the project!
contributePage.donateText: Donations directly help cover project infrastructure, development costs, hosting, and AI developer tooling subscriptions (such as GitHub Copilot / LLM models) that accelerate active coding, bug fixing, and new feature development.
contributePage.donateDisclaimer: mRemoteNG is an open-source project and contributions are not tax deductible.
contributePage.kofi: Buy me a Coffee on Ko-fi
contributePage.codeText: Check out our repository on GitHub, browse open issues or feature requests, and submit a pull request.
contributePage.translateText: Help bring mRemoteNG to users worldwide by helping translate application strings and documentation.
contributePage.ideasText: If you have an idea, suggestion, or feature request, send it directly to us or reach out via our contact page.
contributePage.thanksText: We extend our sincere gratitude to everyone who has submitted pull requests, reported bugs, provided translations, or backed the project financially.
contributePage.backersSubtitle: Honoring our community members and supporters throughout the years.
